_comment: Boccapioppo's entry on the travel map, and its look (docs/locations/river_town.md). Hidden until Monteforchetta's bus line reveals it; the flag is to be agreed with that session.
name: Boccapioppo
desc: A brick town where a clear Alpine river meets the Po, still mopping up after the flood. Poplars, bicycles and a levee warden who knows the river to the centimetre.
